name: headscale-shaped ok
compose:
services:
  headscale:
    image: docker.io/headscale/headscale:0.29.7
    labels:
      traefik.enable: "true"
      traefik.http.routers.headscale.rule: Host(`${PORTCULLIS_HOST_HEADSCALE:-vpn.portcullis.local}`)
      traefik.http.services.headscale.loadbalancer.server.port: "8080"
  console:
    image: docker.io/example/console:1.0.0
    labels:
      traefik.enable: "true"
      traefik.http.routers.console.rule: Host(`${PORTCULLIS_HOST_HEADSCALE:-vpn.portcullis.local}`) && PathPrefix(`/admin`)
      traefik.http.services.console.loadbalancer.server.port: "3000"
  gateway:
    image: docker.io/tailscale/tailscale:v1.90.0
  glue:
    image: docker.io/library/python:3.14-alpine
